purpose: Prove a real static RGBA PNG import/export path can bind standard image pixels to a Mechagotchi sidecar and restore semantic grids without inferring organ metadata from pixels.

external_anchors.used_for: PNG signature, chunk, CRC, zlib IDAT, and filter constraints for the Stage 0 static RGBA decoder.

limitations: Stage 0 decoder supports static non-interlaced 8-bit RGBA PNG only.
Semantic metadata is restored from the Mechagotchi sidecar, not inferred from pixels.
